item.title: Donald Trump says Ukraine peace deal closer after Berlin talks
item.description: US President Donald Trump says a deal to end Russia’s war on Ukraine is “closer than ever” after two days of high-level talks in Berlin, though officials warn major disagreements — especially over territory — remain unresolved.

item.title: Trump files $10bn defamation lawsuit against BBC over 6 Jan documentary
item.description: US President Donald Trump has filed a $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC, accusing the British public broadcaster of deceptively editing a documentary about him and misrepresenting his remarks ahead of the 2024 US presidential election.

item.title: NASA flags shift in stubble-burning timing hindering air quality tracking in north India
item.description: Seasonal crop fires across northern India are increasingly being set later in the day, a shift that scientists warn could complicate monitoring of stubble burning and its impact on air quality, NASA says.

item.title: Goa nightclub fire: Thai authorities deport Luthra brothers to India
item.description: The authorities in Thailand on Tuesday, 16 December, deported to India Gaurav Luthra and Saurabh Luthra, co-owners of the nightclub in Goa where 25 people were killed in a fire on December 6.

item.title: Unidentified drone flies over Nagpur defence firm; investigation launched
item.description: An investigation has been launched after an unidentified drone was spotted flying over the airstrip of Solar Industries, a Nagpur-based manufacturer of defence-related products, officials said on Tuesday.
